name: Curse of Prevarication
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 2, cleric/oracle 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a tooth of a liar)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one creature
Duration 1 day/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

The victim of this curse is unable to tell the truth. While under its effects, the subject must speak the opposite of any truthful phrases it intended. It can choose not to speak, but nothing it says can be true.

Curse of prevarication counters and dispels curse of truth.
